meta.title: Kent Shen — Workbench
meta.description: A workbench for small, useful things — Chrome extensions, apps, games, and web services built by Kent Shen.

ui.colophon: Set in Big Shoulders Display & IBM Plex Mono. Built by hand, no framework.

products.title: JPOP-LYRIC-SYNC-CHROME-EXTENSION
products.desc: My first extension to ship. A floating, draggable lyrics panel for Japanese songs on YouTube — furigana readings, karaoke-style word highlighting with adjustable lead time, and synced Traditional Chinese translation. Built with **kuromoji** tokenization. Live on the Chrome Web Store.

products.title: PEAKS-OF-TAIWAN-WEB
products.desc: The standalone version of the project above — a full **Leaflet** map site with satellite imagery, a filter panel, a hiking checklist, a "dice roll" random-peak picker, and live weather from Taiwan's CWA via a Cloudflare Worker.

products.title: TW-STOCK-REPORT
products.desc: One-click fetch of the latest **TW and US** stock fundamentals — P/E, P/B, dividend yield, gross margin, pre-tax margin, YoY revenue growth — auto-scored into an investment score and health rating, with CSV/JSON export.

products.title: JOB-ANALYZER
products.desc: Paste in a job description — or a CakeResume link for automatic scraping — and get a **six-dimension radar chart** quantifying how exposed the role is to AI automation, with transition advice. Every analysis is saved and gets a shareable short link.

products.title: TRIP-PLANNER
products.desc: An AI-generated multi-country trip planner covering 80+ countries — day-clustered maps with passport-stamp-style markers, a currency converter, practical travel info, local edit mode, and shareable short links.
